findings.thesis: Reject the BDX long entry. I did not recompute price, stop, target or size. The research found verified reasons against buying now, and they are not offset by the specialists' technical support. (1) Bard port-catheter litigation is escalating. A federal jury awarded $40M on Sept 4, 2026 in the second bellwether, the first plaintiff verdict in the MDL. Pending actions rose from over 3,300 in July to 4,140 by Oct 1, and there is no global settlement. The News and Event Agent called the litigation "uncertain" but did not mention the verdict or the case count. (2) Binary events fall inside the likely holding window.
